clienttimers.config.title: Client Alarms
clienttimers.config.messageOnComplete.de: Show a message when an alarm or timer finishes. Completion chat includes Stop and Snooze buttons.
clienttimers.config.messageOnStart.desc: Show a message when an alarm, timer or stopwatch is started.
clienttimers.config.messageOnInfo.desc: Show messages for silence, show/hide, snooze and similar actions.
clienttimers.config.messageDisplay.desc: Where messages appear. Lists always use chat. Titles cannot include clickable buttons.
clienttimers.config.dateOrder.desc: How slash dates are parsed and shown. Type am/pm for 12-hour times, otherwise 24-hour is assumed.
clienttimers.config.alarmEndedFormat.des: Placeholders: %name%, %target%, %elapsed%, %remaining%, %duration%, %mode%, %status%. Leave blank to use the translation.
clienttimers.config.timerEndedFormat.des: Placeholders: %name%, %target%, %elapsed%, %remaining%, %duration%, %mode%, %status%. Leave blank to use the translation.
clienttimers.config.stopwatchStoppedForm: Placeholders: %name%, %elapsed%, %mode%, %status%. Leave blank to use the translation.
clienttimers.config.alarmStartedFormat.d: Placeholders: %name%, %target%, %mode%. Leave blank to use the translation.
clienttimers.config.timerStartedFormat.d: Placeholders: %name%, %duration%, %mode%. Leave blank to use the translation.
clienttimers.config.stopwatchStartedForm: Placeholders: %name%, %mode%. Leave blank to use the translation.
clienttimers.config.overlayByDefault.des: Newly started alarms, timers and stopwatches appear on the HUD unless hidden with the hide command.
While any menu or screen is open and an alarm or timer is sounding, show Stop and Snooze buttons in the top left. The running-timer overlay stays in-world only.
clienttimers.config.silentByDefault.desc: Newly started alarms and timers only show a message and do not play a sound.
clienttimers.config.autoStopAfterRings.d: Stop sounding after this many cycles. 0 means repeat forever until stopped or snoozed away.
clienttimers.config.overlayEnabled.desc: Draw this class of timers on the HUD.
clienttimers.config.showHeading.desc: Draw a heading above this class of timers.
clienttimers.config.heading: Heading text
clienttimers.config.heading.desc: Leave blank to use the translation.
clienttimers.config.overlayFormat.desc: Placeholders: %name%, %remaining%, %elapsed%, %duration%, %target%, %mode%, %status%. Leave blank to use the translation.
clienttimers.config.nameFormat.desc: How %name% is rendered inside the line format. Default %name%.
clienttimers.config.playSounds.desc: Master switch for alarm audio. If this is off, completion messages are shown even when completion messages are disabled.
clienttimers.config.soundVolumeMode.desc: Alarm uses this mod's volume slider and still plays when Minecraft is muted. Game follows Minecraft's UI/master volume.
clienttimers.config.silenceTicks.desc: Ticks to wait after the last note before the sequence repeats.
clienttimers.config.preview.desc: Play the configured alarm on repeat. Stops when you leave the Sound tab or this screen. Invalid notes are skipped.
clienttimers.config.notes.help: Each note is soundId,volume,pitch,tick. Invalid notes are kept, marked with [ERROR], ignored when playing, and do not block saving. Example: minecraft:block.note_block.pling,1.0,1.2,6
clienttimers.button.stopAll.hover: Stop every sounding alarm or timer
clienttimers.button.snooze.hover: Silence currently ringing alarms for 5 minutes
clienttimers.subtitle.actions: Open chat to Stop or Snooze
clienttimers.error.notFound: Nothing with that name is running
clienttimers.error.worldScope: World scope is only available for ticks_playing and time_playing
clienttimers.error.notInWorld: this_world can only be used while you are in a world
clienttimers.error.alarmInPast: That alarm is already in the past
